## Testing Performed

### Manual Testing Checklist

- [ ] Config loads without errors (tested all example configs)
- [ ] Responsive design verified (320px, 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px, 1920px)
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works (Tab, Enter, Escape, Arrow keys)
- [ ] Screen reader tested (NVDA/VoiceOver)
- [ ] Touch interactions work (swipe, tap, scroll)
- [ ] Forms submit correctly (WhatsApp links, contact form)
- [ ] Lightbox/modals open, navigate, close properly
- [ ] Images lazy load, have alt text
- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG AA

- [ ] Edge (latest)
